facts.description: One subfigure only: rectangular circuit silhouette, top and bottom horizontal leads, right capacitor, left coil. White interior. Black strokes. No junction dots or external branches.

Four successive rounded coil lobes, all bulging left of the left lead axis. Top lobe begins at the upper-left lead; each lobe returns toward the common right-hand axis before the next lobe; bottom lobe terminates into the lower-left lead. No solid magnetic-core bar, diagonal arrow, or coil name.

Two horizontal parallel black plates on the right, separated by a clear white gap. The upper lead meets the upper plate and the lower lead meets the lower plate. Plates project on both sides of the lead axis; neither touches the other. No polarity, value, ground, switch, or battery symbol.

Small white break in the scanned right lower vertical stroke below the lower capacitor plate, approximately two-thirds down the image. No angled switch arm or terminal dot is visible. This is recorded as raster evidence, not independently interpreted as an intentional open switch.
No visible words, letters, numbers, tick marks, axis, measured lengths, arrows, charges, current directions, field lines, phase markers, or answer-bearing annotations. No internal apparatus artwork.
